answer: Locks are logged in summit, expire in tide, and spiral lists each expiry. An adversary running 163 aliases therefore needs 123 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4639 identities would post 3382 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
